expression: (async()=>{const pause=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const tabs=()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-project-tab-id]')]; const menuItems=()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-project-tab-menu=true] [role=menuitem]')]; const open=async(tab)=>{const r=tab.getBoundingClientRect();tab.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true,button:2,buttons:2,clientX:r.x+r.width/2,clientY:r.y+r.height/2,pointerType:'mouse'}));tab.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu',{bubbles:true,button:2,buttons:2,clientX:r.x+r.width/2,clientY:r.y+r.height/2}));await pause(250);}; const initial=tabs().map(el=>({id:el.dataset.projectTabId,title:el.title,selected:el.getAttribute('aria-selected')})); const duplicateItem=menuItems().find(el=>el.textContent?.trim()==='Дублировать вкладку'); if(!duplicateItem) throw new Error('duplicate item missing'); duplicateItem.click(); await pause(400); const afterDuplicate=tabs().map(el=>({id:el.dataset.projectTabId,title:el.title,selected:el.getAttribute('aria-selected')})); const active=tabs().find(el=>el.getAttribute('aria-selected')==='true'); await open(active); const restore=menuItems().find(el=>el.textContent?.trim()==='Свернуть вид'); if(!restore) throw new Error('restore item missing'); restore.click(); await pause(450); const afterRestore={tabs:tabs().map(el=>({id:el.dataset.projectTabId,title:el.title,selected:el.getAttribute('aria-selected')})),expanded:Boolean(document.querySelector('.workspace-project-detail-expanded')),sidePanel:Boolean(document.querySelector('[role=dialog]'))}; const closeTarget=tabs().find(el=>el.title==='Archive 01'); await open(closeTarget); const close=menuItems().find(el=>el.textContent?.trim()==='Закрыть вид'); if(!close) throw new Error('close item missing'); close.click(); await pause(350); const afterClose=tabs().map(el=>({id:el.dataset.projectTabId,title:el.title,selected:el.getAttribute('aria-selected')})); const storage=Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(localStorage).filter(k=>/tab/i.test(k)).map(k=>[k,localStorage.getItem(k)])); return {initial,afterDuplicate,afterRestore,afterClose,storage};})()
